ModMetaData.description:
치트성 개조 모드
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Info.png[/img] Update of Rikikis mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=974398773
- Added mod setting to reduce power draw to 25W while idle (no target in range), ramping up to full power while actively drilling - Added gizmo to control power draw and efficiency - Added global settings for unmanned operation, unlimited map range, ignoring walls, drill damage, drill interval, and target search interval - Added a designated-only mining mode that includes both Mine and MineVein designations - Added designated-target priority and numeric text fields alongside the sliders
Supported languages: English, French, German, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.

[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] [h1]MiningCo.: drill turret[/h1]
MiningCo. expeditions often carry one jewel of technology: the drill turret. This device can automatically drill nearby ores and natural rocks.
[img]https://img.litet.net/NljwbRW.png[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2] Adds a new turret: the drill turret. [list] [*]automatically drill nearby ores and natural rocks. [*]mining mode can be switched (only ores, only rocks, both, or only mining-designated targets, including Mine and MineVein). [*]manning the turret will improves its drilling speed (level 20 miner using drill turret mines 2x faster). [*]drill efficiency and yield resources can be improved via one additional research. [*]global mod settings can allow unmanned drilling, remove the range limit, ignore walls, and adjust damage and drilling/search intervals. [*]damage and interval settings can be adjusted with either sliders or numeric text fields. [/list]
[h2]Technical support[/h2] MiningCo. is continuously trying to improve its product to raise its customers satisfaction. Any constructive criticism is always welcome! :)
[h2]Modders note[/h2] You may be interrested in the drawing of dynamic transparent textures.
[h2]License[/h2] You are free to get inspiration from this little work and include it in any other mod/modpack. Just put a link to this thread so people can use it as a standalone version too. So this is basically licensed under http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/ReportingIssues.png[/img] [list] [*] See if the the error persists if you just have this mod and its requirements active. [*] If not, try adding your other mods until it happens again. [*] Always post your log using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Log Uploader[/url] [*] For best support, please use the Discord-channel for error-reporting.
